projectTitle: apiauto.space — Encar, Che168, Copart and IAAI API
description: REST API with used-car listings from Encar (Korea), Che168 (China), Copart and IAAI (USA) in one JSON format: examples in curl, Python, JavaScript and PHP
rules: Send the key in the X-API-Key header; base URL https://api.apiauto.space/v1
Call the API from a server: CORS is off
Paginate with next_cursor; offset is not supported
Quota counts returned cars, not requests; the demo key allows up to 20 cars per request
Photo links expire in about a day: store the car id and fetch a fresh record
